name: Azeroth Companion
title: Sovereign Command Experience — Unified Website Milestone
features: Introduced Sovereign Command v5: a new homepage experience with guided paths for first-time players, returning visitors and friends organizing adventures, linking only to existing installed studios.

Integrated each journey with the current Command Launcher, Character Dominion, Player Guide, Item Atlas, War Room, Progress Command and Sovereign Data Vault; no duplicated studios or account features.
Added website-shell readability controls for Standard, Comfortable and Large text plus a Quiet and focused homepage atmosphere, stored in a separate local browser preference.
Expanded accessibility through Skip to main content, current-tool page titles, screen-reader navigation announcements, active navigation markers and a discreet Return to Top control.
Preserved the complete Assassin Dominion appearance, Quick Deck, update center, on-demand startup, long-list rendering and all pre-v5.0 studio modules.
Preserved secure Battle.net verification and Cloudflare Worker boundaries without new API requests, OAuth permissions, telemetry, account sync or changes to gameplay storage.
Maintained the four-resource site delivery, updated the deterministic bundle source manifest for the new website-only module, and added desktop/mobile browser regression coverage.
Added a dedicated v5 user guide describing journeys, settings, privacy boundaries, accessibility, safe rollback and future maintenance.
